about: Frames the original compositor made, for a look (a curated look's name, or pack pieces joined by +) in a scene: [look, scene, fps, frames, hero, mini, detail, shut], each a sha256 prefix of the frames' rows (rows joined by newlines, frames by a line holding ~; shut is the blink's hero, mini and detail joined by a line holding #, empty when the scene never blinks).
